name: XInsMotorKascoIns
caption: Əlavə modullar / Sığorta / Avto KASKO sığortası

datasets.name: ODSCusts
datasets.sql:
select * from (
SELECT a.id, a.name||' '||a.surname||' '||a.fathername as name, a.ADDRESS
  FROM ins_customers a where a.close_prefix=0
  order by a.surname

)

datasets.name: ODSBanks
datasets.sql:
select * from bankm
order by name

datasets.name: ODSReliaseDates
datasets.sql:
select * from ins_release_date
where to_number(to_char(begindate, 'YYYY')) <= :releaseyear
and to_number(to_char(enddate, 'YYYY')) >= :releaseyear
and state_id in (select its.id from ins_tarif_states its
                  where its.state_id = :state )

datasets.name: ODSMotorKasco
datasets.sql:
SELECT  im.rowid, im.id, im.insuredtype, im.insuredcolor,
       im.insuredoutputyear, im.insuredstatenum, im.underframenum,im.insuredmark||' '||im.insuredmodel as mark,
       im.insuredbannum, im.insuredenginenum, im.driveintended,im.franshiz,val.valute,VAL.VAL_NAME as valyuta,im.close_prefix,
       im.drivecost,im.inssumm,im.ammount, im.typeid, ic.ben_id, im.insuredmark,
       im.insuredmodel, im.bank_id, im.month_id,im.cid,ic.policy_num,ic.beneficiary,ic.ins_date,ic.begin_date, ic.end_date,ic.kli_id,icu.surname||' '||icu.name||' '||icu.fathername as name,iag.name||' '||iag.surname||' '||iag.fathername as agent 
  FROM ins_motorkasco im,  ins_contracts ic,ins_customers icu,ins_agents iag,avalute val
 WHERE  
       ic.id = im.CID
  and  ic.type_id = 1  
  and  ic.close_prefix=0
  and  icu.id=ic.kli_id
  and  iag.id=ic.agent_id
  and val.valute=ic.valute_id order by policy_num desc

datasets.name: ODSContracts
datasets.sql:
select ic.rowid, ic.* from ins_contracts ic
where id = :cid
and type_id = 1

datasets.name: ODSOperkurs
datasets.sql:
select ok.val_kod,ok.ostat,ok.dat from operkurs ok,ins_contracts ic
where ok.dat=ic.ins_date

datasets.name: ODSVal
datasets.sql: select ok.val_kod,ok.ostat,ok.dat from operkurs partition(today) ok,ins_contracts ic

datasets.name: ODSBankm
datasets.sql:
select * from bankm
order by name

datasets.name: ODSPerRates
datasets.sql:
select pr.rowid, pr.* from INS_PERCENT_RATES  pr

where tarif_id = :tarif_id

datasets.name: ODSTariffs
datasets.sql:
select it.rowid, it.* from INS_TARIFFS it

datasets.name: ODSStates
